content: markupmarkdown 1.0 (metavert.io, OSS): 'Google Docs for Markdown'. Drag-select prose to leave threaded margin comments + review state (approve/request-changes/comment) like a PR anchored to prose. Suggested edits render as tracked changes, apply one-click. Policy-based CI doc checks. AI auto-review each revision; agent revisions land as 'proposed', human gate blocks ship. One-click GitHub round-trip. Go binary + React SPA + MongoDB. Single-layer English, team-focused. Closest F3 comparable.
